verdict.rationale: Aleph documents drill-down in its Excel and Google Sheets reporting workflows, financial reporting automation, and agent answers that trace back to cited source data. That covers the drill-to-source part of the story. However, no evidence names P&L, balance sheet, or cash flow statement views, and the drill-down is a one-line claim with no detail on reaching individual source records from any figure. Missing for 10: explicit P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statement views; documented record-level drill-down from any figure; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the model produces P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow views with drill-down from any figure to its source records

citations.quote: Bi-directional Excel and Google Sheets workflows, including pull/push sync, reporting automation, and drill-down.
Put routine financial reporting and closing processes on autopilot
One that you can trace back to the source of truth.
Delivers clear answers with clickable, cited sources that you can review, explore, and trust
